svg.aria-label: How a capability is mounted. The manifest declares files, db, kv, object and ws. At publish each resource kind goes to its Provider, whose ensure creates a volume, a database, a Redis ACL user limited to the app key prefix, and a bucket with its own key, and marks the binding active; ws has no Provider, the gateway handles it. When the app wakes, inject turns each binding into mounts and PNEUMA_SPACE environment variables on the container, and the SDK reads them.
svg.title: How a capability is mounted
svg.text: Declared once in the manifest, provisioned by its Provider at publish, injected when the container is created.
ensure runs on every publish and is safe to repeat; on a suspended binding it is the resume.
remove suspends every binding and keeps the data. Only purge destroys, and only after remove.
